#!/bin/sh
# Known false positives: generic regex matching does not parse heredocs.
cat <<'EXAMPLE'
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
black generated.py
EXAMPLE

# At most one finding per line, even with two native invocations.
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
black generated.py; rustfmt generated.rs
